_comment: Example for store/google-consent.json (untracked, install-specific), read by scripts/google-consent.py. Every consumer gets the same refresh token from one consent, except the ones marked separate, which get their own consent (`link --only NAME`). scopes is the floor a consumer needs (short names get the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/ prefix); the scopes the file already carries are added on top. Paths starting with ~ expand to the home dir, relative paths are relative to the install root. A consumer name must not start with '_'.
